reasonChirho: Stranger, unknown person, foreign, foreigner, non-Greek speaker, lodge/entertain as guest — groups/classes of persons and association.

Bear/endure figuratively, carry/transport physically, bear marks, carry away, bring/fetch — linear movement of transport and endurance.
Cut off, sever, mutilate, castrate, cut down a tree — physical impact of cutting and severing.
Break bread, break/crush/shatter, be broken/crushed — physical impact resulting in division/destruction.
Give, bestow, be given, be granted, put/place, hand to a person — transfer/exchange and placing.
Barracks, palace, citadel, fortified stronghold, fortified/inaccessible — constructions, especially military.
Rejoice greatly, exult, greeting, salutation, rejoice, be glad, make glad — emotions of gladness with communicative acts.
Least, smallest, little ones, small in size/degree, worse, insignificant — degree (low end) and status.
Rise of the sun, dawn figuratively, spring up/arise, cause to rise, rise/stand up — physical events of rising and movement.

Approved/tested, observe/obey, guard/protect, reserve/preserve, keep commandments — discipline/follow and behavior.

Praise God, commend, boast, glory, take pride, laud — communication of praise and religious worship.
Eternity, forever, age, era, world-age, eternity past, world — time domain (cosmic/eternal time).
Escape, avoid judgment, flee physically, turn to flight, rout armies, run away — safety/saving and movement.
Beloved, precious, costly, honored, esteemed, desirable — attitudes/emotions of love and value assessment.
Disbelieve, be faithless, believe, have faith, be entrusted, entrust/commit — holding a view and transfer (entrusting).
Cover, hide, veil, overlay, panel, conceal — features of objects (surface treatment) and concealment.
Pagan deity, God the true God, god, goddess — supernatural beings and powers.
Plague, divine calamity, wound, mortal wound, blow, beating, pestilence — physiological affliction and violence.
Darkness, blackness, gloom, deep darkness — physical state of absence of light.
Seek out, search diligently, require, demand, seek after, desire earnestly, look for — learning through investigation and thinking.
Sin, commit sin, failure, transgression — moral/ethical violation and behavior.
Subject to, held in bondage, restrain, suppress, possess, occupy, hold fast, retain — control/rule and attachment.

Despise, treat with contempt, look down upon, scorn — morally charged attitudes of disdain.
Burden, weight, load, cargo, freight, act of carrying — physical transport and hardship.
Open transitive, be opened passive, opened/standing open, lay open, open wide — features of objects (state) and non-linear movement.
Weigh down, burden, heavy, honor, show respect, set a price, value — status/honor and value assessment.
Kill, put to death, take away, remove, take up, pick up — violence/kill and movement.
Pour out liquid/Spirit, shed blood, pour out, cause to flow, be stretched out — activities involving liquids.
